welcomePage.description_restAppText: A powerful REST API integrated development environment (IDE). This tool provides everything you need to build, test, and debug RESTful services. Key features: smart code completion, interactive API testing, built-in documentation, and team collaboration support. Perfect for developers, testers, and API architects.
welcomePage.description_ourTeamText: Our team consists of experienced developers specializing in modern web applications. We use cutting-edge technologies and best development practices. The IT React course in RSSchool is a great opportunity to master modern frontend development.
